artboards.title: 3 · Today — the board as it is
5 · Worker app — the one new tap

annotations.text:
Six boards in one column, numbered. Opens on the console; use the arrows or the pages menu in the toolbar to step through, or pinch out to see the column.
Every figure across the boards is one set of twelve orders on one Wednesday at 12:10.

Settled in the interview: no status messages to customers; you mark Delivered and then invoice yourself; the team learns by push and the group; transport is hired and confirmed by phone; most customers pay on credit.
